howto.name: Upload an EPUB file
howto.text: Select an .epub e-book file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose page layout
howto.text: Select a page size (A4, Letter, or custom dimensions). The tool reflows text and embeds images to match the chosen layout.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. Chapters, formatting, and embedded images are preserved in the output PDF.

faq.a: Yes. Chapter headings, bold/italic text, embedded images, and basic CSS styling are preserved in the PDF output.
No. DRM-protected e-books cannot be converted. The tool only works with DRM-free EPUB files.

faq.q: What page size options are available?
faq.a: A4, Letter, and custom dimensions. The text is reflowed to fit the chosen page size while keeping chapter breaks.
